facts.claim: Zoya Hameed asked on the first of September for the signed mutual NDA by Thursday, so that Pinecrest could share the pilot data.
On the third of September, the Thursday she named, Arjun wrote back to Zoya with the signed NDA attached.
That answer came about two days after her ask, his one measured reply time in the file.
His mail is the last in the file, and no reply from Pinecrest is on file since.
Zoya's own reply time is not measured, so there is no pattern of hers to judge the quiet by.
The file's situation was last active on the third of September, the day of Arjun's answer.

inferences.claim: Arjun met Zoya's deadline: the signed NDA reached her on the day she named.
With the NDA sent, the next move in the file, sharing the pilot data, is Pinecrest's.

patterns.claim: Arjun met the one dated ask in this file within the time it named.
One closed gap is no rhythm: a quiet longer than the file's only gap, which was Arjun's own answer, says nothing yet about how long Pinecrest takes.

hypotheses.proposition: Pinecrest is preparing the pilot data and will send it unprompted.
hypotheses.needs: The data, or a note from Zoya.

hypotheses.proposition: The pilot has slowed at Pinecrest for reasons of its own.

unknowns.question: When Pinecrest means to share the pilot data.
unknowns.relevance: Only a date Pinecrest names, and then lets pass, would make the quiet worth raising.

unknowns.question: Whether Pinecrest has signed the mutual NDA on its own side.
unknowns.relevance: It would explain a quiet spell with nothing owed by Arjun.

frames.primary: An ask answered in full: Zoya asked for the signed mutual NDA by Thursday, you sent it signed on the third, and the next move is Pinecrest's.
rivals: An NDA that Pinecrest still has to sign on its side before any data moves.
A pilot that has slowed at Pinecrest for reasons that have nothing to do with the NDA.

proposed_kind.why: Zoya asks for a mutual NDA so that Pinecrest can share pilot data with Nimbus Labs: a pilot on a partner's data is design partner work, one of the brief's goals.

expected_vs_actual.expected: No playbook applies and the brief names no kind of work for this file; once the signed NDA is sent, Pinecrest shares the pilot data when it is ready.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Arjun sent the signed NDA on the third, by the Thursday Zoya named; nothing has come from Pinecrest since, and nothing in the file is owed by Arjun.

scenarios.do_nothing: Nothing is lost: the ask is met, and the pilot data comes when Pinecrest is ready.
scenarios.act: Writing again now would add nothing; the move is Pinecrest's.
scenarios.best: Pinecrest shares the pilot data and the pilot begins.
scenarios.worst: The pilot slows at Pinecrest, and the file stays quiet for reasons Arjun cannot see.
signals_to_watch: The pilot data arriving from Pinecrest
A note from Zoya, or the NDA signed on Pinecrest's side
A date Pinecrest names for the data

reasons: The one ask in the file was met within the time Zoya set.
Nothing in the file is owed by Arjun.
Quiet after a signed document is sent is, on its own, no sign of trouble.

parsed.alternative: None is needed; the file can rest until Pinecrest writes.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Nothing to wait on from your side; treat the NDA ask as closed and look again only when Pinecrest writes.
parsed.done_when: The NDA ask is closed with the signed copy sent; the file needs nothing more until Pinecrest moves.
